claims.measurement: encode held-out split; decode with ONLY the level-1 index; residual energy / signal energy
claims.failure:
- codebook overfit -> held-out worse than train (drift/fail)
- source distribution shift -> level-1 codes no longer stand alone
- VOID rate at level 1 >> target -> level 1 never stood alone

claims.measurement: per sample: |z|^2 - (|z_hat|^2 + |r|^2) == 2<z_hat,r>; identity holds only if the split is orthogonal; report worst relative magnitude over held-out split
claims.failure:
- non-orthogonal codebook entries -> defect != 0: the
  effort/flow energy reading of this substrate is VOID,
  use bookkeeping reading only

claims.measurement: count held-out residuals whose min distance exceeds tau_k that were nevertheless snapped to a code (must be zero)
claims.failure:
- threshold not applied at some level -> silent snap returns
- VOID index collides with a real code index -> misdecode
claims.note: encode() routes every over-threshold residual to the reserved VOID index by construction; the measured value is a structural 0.0 and the claim is falsified by any code path that snaps past tau_k

claims.measurement: full index-tuple census over held-out split: 1 - distinct_paths/n; two samples collide iff their entire code path (VOID positions included) is identical
claims.failure:
- degenerate/discrete source -> collision rate >> train
- per-level input census substituted for full-path census ->
  degenerate 0.0 on continuous floats (false pass)
